records.title: Quantized Evolution Strategies: High-precision Fine-tuning of Quantized LLMs at Low-precision Cost
records.reason: Technique reduces fine-tuning optimizer memory, not inference cost; keep borderline because low-precision model adaptation may inform deployment quantization.

records.title: Seg-MoE: Multi-Resolution Segment-wise Mixture-of-Experts for Time Series Forecasting Transformers
records.reason: MoE routing is for time-series forecasting and has no LLM serving evaluation; retain only as a weak routing analogy.

records.title: DR-LoRA: Dynamic Rank LoRA for Fine-Tuning Mixture-of-Experts Models
records.reason: DR-LoRA dynamically allocates LoRA ranks to experts during MoE fine-tuning and evaluates training/adaptation quality. The intervention is a parameter-efficient training method; it does not change inference execution, memory, or serving latency.
